<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en" class="dark" data-sc-cs="background-color:oklch(0.98 0.01 240);color:rgb(0, 0, 0)" data-sc-content-width="1416"><head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Flux Capital | Real-Time Financial Intelligence</title>

    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <script src="https://code.iconify.design/iconify-icon/1.0.7/iconify-icon.min.js"></script>

    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin="">
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

    <style>
        :root {
            color-scheme: light;
            --white: oklch(98% 0.01 240);
            --white-2: oklch(96.8% 0.01 240);
            --graphite: oklch(18% 0.05 30);
            --graphite-2: oklch(14% 0.04 30);
            --slate: oklch(52% 0.09 255);
            --slate-2: oklch(64% 0.11 255);
            --blue: oklch(71% 0.15 255);
            --ink: oklch(18% 0.02 240);
        }

        * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            margin: 0;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            font-family: "Inter Tight", sans-serif;
            background:
                radial-gradient(circle at 14% 10%, rgba(80, 128, 196, .08), transparent 16%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 84% 14%, rgba(0, 0, 0, .035), transparent 15%),
                linear-gradient(180deg, var(--white) 0%, var(--white-2) 100%);
            color: var(--ink);
        }

        body::before {
            content: "";
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(0, 0, 0, .03) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, .03) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 120px 120px;
            opacity: .26;
            z-index: -2;
        }

        .mono {
            font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace;
        }

        .display {
            font-weight: 900;
        }

        .audit-bar {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0 0 auto 0;
            z-index: 80;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .82);
            backdrop-filter: blur(14px) brightness(1.02);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
        }

        .audit-inner {
            width: min(1600px, calc(100% - 28px));
            margin: 0 auto;
            min-height: 64px;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
            gap: 16px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .brand {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 14px;
            min-width: 0;
        }

        .brand-mark {
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            display: grid;
            place-items: center;
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, .12);
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .98), rgba(247, 247, 247, .9));
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        .brand-copy {
            min-width: 0;
        }

        .brand-copy .name {
            font-size: 11px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
        }

        .brand-copy .sub {
            margin-top: 4px;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .86);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .audit-nav {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 20px;
            overflow-x: auto;
            scrollbar-width: none;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
        }

        .audit-nav::-webkit-scrollbar {
            display: none;
        }

        .audit-nav a {
            text-decoration: none;
            color: inherit;
            white-space: nowrap;
            transition: .25s ease;
        }

        .audit-nav a:hover {
            color: var(--slate);
        }

        .audit-actions {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .meter {
            width: 220px;
            height: 8px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
            overflow: hidden;
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        .meter span {
            display: block;
            height: 100%;
            width: 78%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(65, 120, 196, .88), rgba(116, 165, 255, .98));
        }

        .aero {
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            height: 40px;
            padding: 0 16px;
            border-radius: 3px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, .12);
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .98), rgba(246, 246, 246, .86));
            color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .84);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-size: 10px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: transform .45s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1), border-color .35s ease, box-shadow .35s ease;
            box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .9);
        }

        .aero::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            opacity: 0;
            background:
                linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(74, 145, 255, .26), transparent);
            transition: .35s ease;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .aero:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            border-color: rgba(74, 145, 255, .4);
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .96),
                0 0 0 1px rgba(74, 145, 255, .14);
        }

        .aero:hover::after {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .hero {
            position: relative;
            min-height: 100svh;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            background: var(--white);
            padding-top: 64px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .hero-grid {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 10;
            width: min(1600px, calc(100% - 28px));
            margin: 0 auto;
            min-height: calc(100svh - 64px);
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            align-items: stretch;
        }

        .hero-copy {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 4;
            padding: 72px 24px 48px 0;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: flex-start;
            background: transparent;
            border-right: none;
        }

        .hero-side {
            position: relative;
            background: transparent;
            overflow: visible;
            min-height: calc(100svh - 64px);
        }

        .video-shell {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            z-index: 1;
            overflow: hidden;
            -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent 0%, transparent 20%, black 55%, black 100%);
            mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent 0%, transparent 20%, black 55%, black 100%);
            filter: saturate(1.06) contrast(1.04) brightness(.96);
        }

        .hero-copy-inner {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 640px;
            padding: 18px 18px 18px 0;
        }

        .eyebrow {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            padding: 10px 14px;
            border-radius: 3px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .72);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .62);
            backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
        }

        .eyebrow span {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            background: var(--blue);
            display: inline-block;
        }

        .hero-title {
            margin-top: 22px;
            font-size: clamp(4.6rem, 8.8vw, 8.8rem);
            line-height: .86;
            color: #080808;
            text-transform: none;
        }

        .hero-title .line {
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        .hero-title .line span {
            display: inline-block;
            transform: translateY(100%);
            opacity: 0;
            filter: blur(8px);
        }

        .typed {
            animation: typedIn .8s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) forwards;
        }

        .glitch {
            position: relative;
            display: inline-block;
        }

        .glitch::before,
        .glitch::after {
            content: attr(data-text);
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 0;
            width: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            opacity: .6;
            pointer-events: none;
            clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0);
        }

        .glitch::before {
            transform: translate(1px, 0);
            color: #4a87ff;
            animation: glitchA 1.8s infinite linear alternate-reverse;
        }

        .glitch::after {
            transform: translate(-1px, 0);
            color: #9ec0ff;
            animation: glitchB 2.2s infinite linear alternate-reverse;
        }

        .hero-copy-text {
            margin-top: 24px;
            max-width: 560px;
            font-size: 16px;
            line-height: 2;
            color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .72);
        }

        .hero-specs {
            margin-top: 20px;
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .hero-specs span {
            padding: 10px 12px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .84);
            border-radius: 3px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .62);
        }

        .hero-actions {
            margin-top: 26px;
            display: flex;
            gap: 12px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .hero-actions button {
            height: 46px;
            padding: 0 18px;
            border-radius: 3px;
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 10px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
    
        .video-shell {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0 -12% 0 -8%;
            z-index: 2;
            overflow: hidden;
            -webkit-mask: url(#dataPulseMask);
            mask: url(#dataPulseMask);
            filter: saturate(1.06) contrast(1.04) brightness(.96);
        }

        .video-shell video {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            transform: scale(1.06);
            will-change: transform;
        }

        .video-shell::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background:
                radial-gradient(circle at 18% 20%, rgba(255, 255, 255, .18), transparent 16%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 65% 28%, rgba(77, 143, 255, .2), transparent 14%),
                linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .08), rgba(0, 0, 0, .18));
            z-index: 2;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .video-shell::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: -2%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .22), transparent 24%);
            pointer-events: none;
            mix-blend-mode: screen;
        }

        .ticker-stack {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 20px 18px 20px auto;
            z-index: 6;
            width: min(360px, 46%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .ticker {
            padding: 14px 16px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .1);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);
            backdrop-filter: blur(40px) brightness(1.1);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(40px) brightness(1.1);
            color: white;
            border-radius: 3px;
            box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .1);
        }

        .ticker .top {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 16px;
            align-items: center;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: black;
        }

        .ticker .value {
            margin-top: 10px;
            font-size: 28px;
            line-height: 1;
            color: #050505;
        }

        .ticker .small {
            margin-top: 8px;
            font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace;
            font-size: 13px;
            line-height: 1.7;
            color: black;
        }

        .section {
            padding: 110px 0;
        }

        .shell {
            width: min(1600px, calc(100% - 28px));
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .section-h {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 22px;
            align-items: flex-end;
            margin-bottom: 26px;
        }

        .section-h h2 {
            font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 5.2vw, 5.8rem);
            line-height: .88;
            color: #090909;
        }

        .section-h p {
            max-width: 430px;
            color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .66);
            line-height: 1.95;
        }

        .dual-stream {
            position: relative;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: .45fr .55fr;
            gap: 18px;
            align-items: stretch;
        }

        .ledger-panel {
            padding: 38px;
            background:
                linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .95), rgba(248, 248, 248, .84));
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        .ledger-panel .label {
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .54);
        }

        .ledger-panel h3 {
            margin-top: 16px;
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 4.3rem);
            line-height: .9;
            color: #050505;
        }

        .ledger-panel p {
            margin-top: 18px;
            line-height: 2;
            color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .68);
            max-width: 52ch;
        }

        .audit-list {
            margin-top: 22px;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
        }

        .audit-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
            gap: 14px;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 14px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
            font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .7);
        }

        .audit-row strong {
            color: #000;
            font-family: inherit;
        }

        .monitor {
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            border-radius: 3px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
            background:
                linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .9), rgba(245, 247, 250, .82));
            min-height: 580px;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        }

        .monitor::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background:
                linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .42), transparent 20%),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(74, 143, 255, .08), transparent 52%);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .monitor .pane {
            padding: 22px;
            border-right: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
        }

        .monitor .pane:last-child {
            border-right: none;
        }

        .pane-head {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 14px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
        }

        .box {
            margin-top: 16px;
            padding: 18px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .9);
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        .box .name {
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .5);
        }

        .box .amount {
            margin-top: 10px;
            font-size: 34px;
            color: #050505;
        }

        .box .desc {
            margin-top: 10px;
            color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .66);
            line-height: 1.85;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .mini-graph {
            margin-top: 18px;
            width: 100%;
            height: 160px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
            background:
                linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .96), rgba(246, 248, 251, .86));
            border-radius: 3px;
            padding: 16px;
        }

        .metrics {
            margin-top: 18px;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .metric {
            padding: 16px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .92);
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        .metric .k {
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
        }

        .metric .v {
            margin-top: 10px;
            font-size: 28px;
            color: #050505;
        }

        .telemetry {
            padding: 110px 0;
            background:
                linear-gradient(180deg, #0f1114 0%, #11151a 100%);
            color: white;
        }

        .telemetry-shell {
            width: min(1600px, calc(100% - 28px));
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .telemetry-head {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 20px;
            align-items: flex-end;
            margin-bottom: 28px;
        }

        .telemetry-head h2 {
            font-size: clamp(2.7rem, 5.4vw, 5.6rem);
            line-height: .88;
        }

        .telemetry-head p {
            max-width: 440px;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .66);
            line-height: 1.95;
        }

        .grid-board {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr);
            gap: 16px;
        }

        .tile {
            grid-column: span 4;
            min-height: 220px;
            padding: 20px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
            background:
                linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .05), rgba(255, 255, 255, .02));
            border-radius: 3px;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(24px);
            transition: opacity .6s ease, transform .6s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1);
        }

        .tile.in {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .tile::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background:
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(73, 136, 255, .18), transparent 60%),
                linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .04), transparent 25%);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .tile .t {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .55);
        }

        .tile h3 {
            margin-top: 18px;
            font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 2.8vw, 2.8rem);
            line-height: .95;
            color: white;
        }

        .tile p {
            margin-top: 14px;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .68);
            line-height: 1.85;
            max-width: 42ch;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .tile svg {
            width: 100%;
            height: 84px;
            margin-top: 16px;
            overflow: visible;
        }

        .tile.wide {
            grid-column: span 8;
        }

        .tile.tall {
            min-height: 278px;
        }

        .telemetry-foot {
            margin-top: 16px;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 16px;
        }

        .signal {
            padding: 18px 20px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .03);
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        .signal .name {
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .52);
        }

        .signal .value {
            margin-top: 10px;
            font-size: 30px;
        }

        .ledger-footer {
            padding: 110px 0 90px;
            background:
                linear-gradient(180deg, #111 0%, #0b0c0f 100%);
            color: white;
        }

        .ledger-shell {
            width: min(1600px, calc(100% - 28px));
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr .9fr;
            gap: 18px;
        }

        .ledger-card {
            padding: 36px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .03);
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        .ledger-card h2 {
            font-size: clamp(2.7rem, 5vw, 5.2rem);
            line-height: .9;
        }

        .ledger-card p {
            margin-top: 16px;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .68);
            line-height: 2;
            max-width: 760px;
        }

        pre {
            margin: 0;
            white-space: pre-wrap;
            word-break: break-word;
            font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            line-height: 1.95;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .78);
        }

        .capabilities {
            display: grid;
            gap: 14px;
        }

        .cap {
            padding: 18px 20px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .03);
            border-radius: 3px;
            font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            line-height: 1.8;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .76);
        }

        .bottom-line {
            margin-top: 24px;
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, .25), transparent);
        }

        .footer-bar {
            margin-top: 18px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 20px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .55);
            font-size: 12px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        @keyframes typedIn {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                filter: blur(10px);
                transform: translateY(12px);
            }

            to {
                opacity: 1;
                filter: blur(0);
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }

        @keyframes glitchA {
            0% {
                clip-path: inset(0 0 92% 0);
            }

            20% {
                clip-path: inset(12% 0 78% 0);
            }

            40% {
                clip-path: inset(54% 0 30% 0);
            }

            60% {
                clip-path: inset(28% 0 56% 0);
            }

            80% {
                clip-path: inset(64% 0 14% 0);
            }

            100% {
                clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0);
            }
        }

        @keyframes glitchB {
            0% {
                clip-path: inset(84% 0 0 0);
            }

            20% {
                clip-path: inset(72% 0 8% 0);
            }

            40% {
                clip-path: inset(18% 0 58% 0);
            }

            60% {
                clip-path: inset(42% 0 32% 0);
            }

            80% {
                clip-path: inset(6% 0 80% 0);
            }

            100% {
                clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0);
            }
        }

        @keyframes sheen {
            to {
                transform: translateX(240%) rotate(10deg);
            }
        }

        ::view-transition-old(root),
        ::view-transition-new(root) {
            animation-duration: .72s;

            const translate = progress * 18;

            if (heroVideo) {
                heroVideo.style.transform = `scale(${scale}) translateY(${translate}px)`;
            }
        }

        function animateCount(el) {
            const target = parseFloat(el.dataset.count || '0');
            const duration = 1300;
            const start = performance.now();

            const step = (now) => {
                const p = Math.min((now - start) / duration, 1);
                const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
                const value = target * eased;
                el.textContent = target >= 10 ? Math.round(value).toLocaleString() : value.toFixed(1);

            };

            requestAnimationFrame(step);
        }
